title: The General's Toast
location: Army Day Gala — Officers' Mess, Ashenmere

narrative.text: The Army Day Gala is a sea of pressed uniforms and medals. You stand at the head of the table. General Brenner rises, raises his glass, and the room falls silent. The cameras are flashing.
I raise my glass to the Republic. And I raise my glass to the patience of the military. May the Republic never test that patience too severely.
He didn't toast the Chancellor. He toasted the 'patience of the military.' It's a veiled threat. A public warning. The cameras caught it. You have to respond, and the whole officer corps is watching.

He did it. He looked me in the eye and told the army to be patient with me. It's a dare. If I back down, I look weak. If I lash out, I provoke the very coup he is hinting at. I have to choose my words like a surgeon.

choices.text: Toast back: 'And to the obedience of the military. May it never waver.'
Laugh it off as a joke. Defuse the tension.
Publicly fire him on the spot. 'Your patience is no longer required, General.'

narrative.text: The room goes very still. Brenner's glass is still raised. He holds it there for a moment, then drinks — slowly, watching me over the rim. The other officers follow. Nobody laughs. Vyktor exhales beside me. The cameras get the image: Chancellor and General, glasses raised, eyes level. What it looks like in the morning papers depends entirely on the caption.

I laughed. Not a politician's laugh — a real one, short and dry. 'The General keeps us all humble,' I said. The room relaxed on cue. Brenner smiled. The cameras caught a pleasant evening at the Officers' Mess, which is exactly what Vyktor wanted and exactly what Brenner expected. He will try again with something that can't be laughed off.

The room went silent the way rooms go silent when something irreversible has just happened. Brenner set his glass down. He did not argue. He nodded once — the nod of a man who expected this, or wanted it — and walked out through the side door. Three generals followed him. Four stayed seated. Vyktor spent the rest of the evening working out which four and what it means.
